items.html: It is found, accordingly, that the world of Atzilut — its discernment is Hochma; the discernment of the world of Beriah is Bina; the discernment of Yetzirah is in Tifferet; and the discernment of Assiyah is in Malchut. And all this is clear, and there is no need to elaborate on it, for just as the world of Atzilut itself divides into these four discernments, so they are the inclusion of these four worlds. And behold, opposite Atzilut it is said, "all of them You have made in wisdom," because all of Atzilut was made in the secret of Hochma.
